early.interval_scope: Unadjusted descriptive paired bootstrap across people; no significance declaration.

claim_scope: Exploratory early/late prompted-task decoding; no separate cue/imagery onset.
conclusion: No demonstrated TimesFM early-window advantage or useful five-word decoding. Raw temporal features improve within-recording early-versus-late performance, but still fail uniform log loss and have an unresolved shuffled-adjusted timing gain.

bootstrap_provenance.reuse: One shared draws array across timing contrasts and metrics; early comparison scorer independently creates the same seeded array.
bootstrap_provenance.interval: numpy.quantile of bootstrap means at [0.025,0.975], default linear method

independent_review.scope: Read-only implementation, source timing interpretation and public aggregate verification
independent_review.arithmetic: 24 early and 24 late means, six timing and six shuffle-adjusted contrasts, 18 early comparisons, positive-person counts; maximum mean difference 4.4e-16
